text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sky, which had been overcast until right before the race,
cleared up brilliantly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That was amazing... You really gave it your all!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the audience...
and everyone in the Mejiro family—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"To think that so many people
are celebrating my victory..."
choice_data_list: It just shows how incredible it really is!
It just shows how incredible it really is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Only now do I feel
I finally understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What kind of goal had I set for myself—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just how much joy awaits us
beyond achieving that goal...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes...... More than words can express!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There were times I lost my way, times I struggled.
But I'm so glad I never gave up...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family's first-ever Spring-Autumn Double Tenno Sho victory—because we were able to achieve that...!!
